steps.what: Find actual specialized sociology materials for the outside reading assignment
inputs: OTHER: scholarly catalogue and reference manager
outputs: Located candidate sources with catalogue identifiers

steps.what: Read and select actual materials for sociological relevance, level, perspective and student access
inputs: Assignment objectives and student access constraints
outputs: Selected actual sources and required editions

steps.what: Import the selected sources' actual bibliographic metadata from catalogue records
outputs: Staged bibliography records and unresolved metadata fields

steps.what: Compile the bibliography in the actual required citation style from the staged records
outputs: Complete draft reading bibliography

steps.what: Check every final citation, edition and access link against actual sources and the reading assignment
outputs: Complete checked final reading bibliography

steps.what: Publish the exact checked bibliography to the course reading page
inputs: Exact final bibliography checked in s5
outputs: Published outside-reading bibliography

tasks.design: Configure saved catalogue searches and native metadata imports in {OTHER}, then generate the citation list in {DOCS}. The teacher reads and selects actual sociology sources and checks the complete bibliography before its separate publication to {LMS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated metadata entry and citation formatting add clerical work to scholarly selection.
tasks.enabler_now: Reference managers can import actual catalogue metadata and apply declared citation styles.
tasks.still_hard: Source relevance, intellectual perspective and suitability for students remain academic judgments.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher chooses what students should read and verifies the actual sources.

ambition.what: Reduce handling of actual specialized reading sources.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: reference managers can import catalogue metadata and format citations for actual selected sources.

assumptions: Unmeasured bibliography-compilation episode with manual metadata and style work; shares are independent of the prompt prior.

Catalogue owners produce metadata; s1 counts retrieval, s2 actual source reading and selection, and s5 complete metadata, link and edition verification. No model-generated titles or citations are accepted.
s3 and s4 are separate native machine actions. Missing or conflicting metadata stops import for manual resolution in s5. Existing equivalent import and formatting earn no additional saving.
s6 is a separately gated publication of the exact final list; changed entries require renewed checking. Its effectively immediate action earns no saving and sends no hidden email.
Gross 41 minus 4 upkeep gives 37 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
research_questions: Which metadata fields and style adjustments remain manual?

already_counted.description: Retained retrieval, source reading and complete bibliography checking

incremental.description: Maintain search filters, catalogue connectors and citation style and check changed metadata formats

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete bibliography and course audience checked in s5; changed entries require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 6 retrieval plus 20 metadata plus 15 formatting = 41 gross, minus 4 upkeep = 37 net. Existing equivalent automation lowers additional benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read and check the actual funding call and proposal requirements
inputs: Actual funder's current call and application template
outputs: Checked requirements and actual deadline

steps.what: Develop the actual sociological question, argument, research design and contribution
inputs: Actual scholarly evidence and research ideas
outputs: Authored scientific case and study design

steps.what: Develop and verify the actual research resources, budget and feasible timetable
outputs: Checked budget and timetable

steps.what: Assemble the actual verified institutional and project fields into the funder's template
inputs: Checked budget and actual call template
outputs: Staged proposal with factual fields and missing items marked

steps.what: Write and edit the proposal narrative from the teacher's actual scientific case and verified facts
inputs: Authored scientific case and actual source citations
outputs: Complete draft grant proposal

loop.purpose: Draft narrative wording from the actual authored research argument
loop.input: Teacher's case, verified facts and actual source citations
loop.output: Draft proposal narrative with source-linked claims
loop.check: Teacher edits against the original argument, sources and call
loop.stop: Missing facts, unsupported claims or altered study commitments require manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Narrative synthesis needs more than exact field insertion

steps.what: Check the complete final proposal for scientific accuracy, citations, budget, commitments and call compliance
inputs: Original sources, design, budget and call
outputs: Complete checked final written proposal

steps.what: Save the exact checked final written grant proposal
inputs: Exact final proposal checked in s6
outputs: Saved final written proposal with actual institutional approval status

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} fields for the actual proposal template and a bounded drafting loop for wording derived from the teacher's authored argument. Keep research design, {SPREADSHEET} budget and complete final proposal checking with the teacher before saving the exact written version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated factual assembly and narrative redrafting add work to developing the actual research case.
tasks.enabler_now: Template fields handle exact facts; a bounded model can draft wording from a supplied argument and sources.
tasks.still_hard: The research question, feasible design, resource commitments and defensible scientific claims remain the teacher's work.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher owns the intellectual contribution and proposal commitments.

ambition.what: Reduce preparation effort for an actual research proposal.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 for confidential proposal and institutional-data consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document fields can assemble verified proposal facts and bounded language drafting can reword an authored argument subject to full source checking.

assumptions: Unmeasured grant-writing episode; shares are independent of the prompt prior.

The funder supplies the actual call; institutional owners supply current facts and cost rates. s1 counts call checking, s2 actual scientific authorship and s3 budget development and verification. No free finished argument, invented rates or generated citations are assumed.

s4 assembles exact fields; missing facts remain marked for manual resolution. s5 uses only permitted confidential inputs and does not invent results or change design. If language assistance is not permitted, retain manual narrative writing.

s6 checks the complete final version. s7 only saves it with honest actual institutional approval status. Submission and any institutional approval occur separately after the final version exists; no submission is hidden here. Same-system save earns no saving.
Use existing native templates first; equivalent current assembly earns no new gain. Gross 25 minus 4 upkeep gives 21 net per 100 baseline focal hours.
unknowns: Actual funder and institutional drafting rules
Current repeated factual assembly and editing effort
research_questions: Which proposal fields are already populated?
Can every draft claim be traced to the authored case?

already_counted.description: Retained call checking, scientific authorship, budget work, narrative editing and complete final checking

incremental.description: Maintain template mappings, permitted drafting context and source-linked claim checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete written proposal checked in s6; changed wording or commitments require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 2 call-handling plus 15 factual assembly plus 8 narrative handling = 25 gross, minus 4 upkeep = 21 net.

steps.what: Locate and check the actual faculty member's question and relevant current department guidance
inputs: Current department teaching and research guidance
outputs: Checked context and relevant current guidance

steps.what: Mentor the new faculty member through actual teaching, research and departmental questions
outputs: Faculty member receives situation-specific mentoring and agreed next steps

tasks.design: Link the existing current department guidance in {DOCS} so the mentor can retrieve it quickly. Keep actual mentoring, listening and situation-specific academic advice with the teacher.
tasks.previous_blocker: Searching for current department guidance can add preparation to mentoring.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links and version labels can expose existing approved guidance.
tasks.still_hard: Trust, academic judgment and personal teaching or research concerns require a human relationship.
tasks.human_edge: The mentor understands the colleague's situation and gives accountable advice.

ambition.what: Make existing guidance easier to retrieve during mentoring.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: current-document links can reduce guidance retrieval without reducing the actual mentoring conversation.

assumptions: Unmeasured mentoring episode with actual guidance lookup; shares are independent of the prompt prior. Already available guidance earns no lookup saving.
Department owners maintain existing guidance; s1 counts retrieval and verification. s2 counts the actual mentoring conversation and agreed next steps.
No required mentor report, personnel assessment, follow-up message or shared-note write is established, so none is invented or assumed free. No calendar setup is charged to each conversation.
Gross 3 minus 1 upkeep gives 2 net per 100 baseline focal hours.
research_questions: Which mentoring questions require a current document lookup?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 15 times 20% = 3 gross, minus 1 upkeep = 2 net. Actual mentoring time is retained.

tasks.short: Support student recruitment, registration and placement

steps.what: Participate in student recruitment conversations about actual sociology course options and goals
outputs: Actual program discussion and identified student needs

steps.what: Collect and verify actual student registration documents, identities and course preferences
inputs: Student's actual application and supporting documents
OPS_SYSTEM: existing application and student registration system
outputs: Verified source registration fields and unresolved evidence gaps

steps.what: Stage verified application fields into the actual separate registration record using exact identifiers
inputs: Verified source registration fields from s2
Explicit application-to-registry field and identity mappings
outputs: Staged registration entry and unmatched fields

steps.what: Discuss actual sociology course placement and resolve registration exceptions with the student and responsible staff
inputs: Verified qualifications and actual course requirements
Student's goals and actual delegated authority
outputs: Actual placement advice and resolved or pending case decisions

steps.what: Complete and check the entire final registration case entry against evidence and actual placement status
inputs: Staged registration entry and unmatched fields
Actual case decisions and pending approvals
outputs: Complete checked final registration case entry

steps.what: Commit the exact checked registration case entry to the existing student record
inputs: Exact case entry checked in s5
outputs: Saved registration case with actual decision status

tasks.design: Configure a native {OPS_SYSTEM} application-to-registration import for actual verified fields. The teacher retains student discussions, evidence verification, placement exceptions and checking the complete final registry entry before its separate commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rekeying actual application details into a separate registration record adds work to student support.
tasks.enabler_now: Native field mappings can stage exact verified registration values without a predictive student model.
tasks.still_hard: Student goals, nonstandard qualifications and placement exceptions remain decisions for authorized people.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher discusses sociological preparation and resolves actual academic case questions.

ambition.what: Reduce duplicate registration entry where it actually remains.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit application-to-registry field mappings can stage verified values while leaving qualification and placement decisions with people.

assumptions: Unmeasured case-support episode in which the teacher actually rekeys a separate registration record. This is conditional, not an invented institution-wide baseline. Shares are independent of the prompt prior; other recruitment activities have different work mixes.

Students produce actual documents; s2 counts their receipt and verification. s3's exact field producer is s2, not an assumed clean feed. Missing identities, contradictory evidence and unmatched fields stop the import for manual resolution in s4 and s5.
Use native imports first. Existing equivalent synchronization is baseline and earns no additional saving. No model ranks students, decides admission or assigns educational levels.

s5 includes actual remaining record capture and complete final verification. The commit records honest pending or resolved status; it does not send an admission offer, placement letter or hidden notification. Its effectively immediate save earns no saving.
Gross 25 minus 3 upkeep gives 22 net per 100 baseline focal hours. No extrapolation across all recruitment events without measuring their mix.
unknowns: Whether this actual registration rekeying belongs to the teacher
Current native synchronization and case authority
research_questions: Which fields are actually copied from applications to separate registration records?

already_counted.description: Retained evidence verification, placement discussion and complete final case checking

incremental.description: Maintain exact application mappings and test identity and schema changes with the registry owner

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete case entry and actual decision status checked in s5; edits require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional case estimate: 25 actual rekeying hours removed, minus 3 upkeep = 22 net. Existing equivalent synchronization or a case with no rekeying has no import saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Library owners supply actual catalogue records.
Institutional funding and registry owners retain source and decision authority.
